QuestInfo.name: Runaway Brother
QuestInfo.0: Jay is worried about his younger brother. Go talk to Jay.
QuestInfo.1: Jay has a younger step brother named Alex. Alex had a hard time adjusting to their new life and ran away. All his family members are worried about him.
QuestInfo.2: Jay has a younger step brother named Alex. Alex had a hard time adjusting to their new life and ran away. All his family members are worried about him.

0.0: #h0#, you travel all over, right? \r\nSay, if you're doing people favors, could you help me with something?

1.0: I have a younger brother... stepbrother, actually. Stan's my stepfather, and Alex is my stepbrother.
1.1: \r\nWhen Stan married my mom, I was okay with it... but Alex didn't take it so well. He ran away from home a while ago, and hasn't been back since. He sent me a letter from Kerning City, saying he's doing okay, but... I want him to come back.
1.2: \r\nIf you happen to stop by Kerning City, please check and see how he's doing.

yes.0: \r\nI know he misses his mother, but I miss Alex.\r\nI hope he knows how much we all care about him.
